Consertus is an AI-native global capital program management and advisory firm that combines deep industry expertise with advanced digital capabilities to deliver smarter, faster, and more sustainable outcomes. Headquartered in Miami, Florida, and supported by a team of more than 1,400 professionals, we help clients plan, deliver, and optimize complex capital programs across the full project lifecycle.

We serve a diverse range of industries, including aviation, transportation, transit, water, healthcare, energy, education, government, commercial real estate, life sciences, and technology.

At Consertus, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We foster a collaborative, flexible, and inclusive environment where individuals can grow, develop their skills, and make a meaningful impact. Together, we're transforming the way the world is planned, built, and delivered.

Learn more about how Consertus is creating lasting value for clients, communities, and our people at .

About this Role:

The Senior Construction Auditor is responsible for performing detailed reviews and analyses of construction applications for payment and professional service invoices on assigned projects and programs. This role focuses on verifying that billed costs are accurate, properly supported, and compliant with contract requirements, applicable policies, and established invoice review and exception-handling procedures.

The Senior Construction Auditor/Compliance Analyst works in a dynamic, multi-vendor environment and supports projects delivered under various construction project delivery approaches. This position requires a solid understanding of construction contracts and invoice processing, along with the ability to identify, document, and communicate compliance issues effectively.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Follow established invoice review procedures, instructions, and exception-handling processes.
  • Read, interpret, and understand construction contract provisions related to invoice processing and payment, translating contract requirements into actionable compliance testing.
  • Demonstrate a working understanding of various contract structures and associated cost controls.
  • Verify that each invoice has all required contractual authorizations prior to approval.
  • Understand the scope of work associated with the construction project being billed and assess whether invoiced costs align with approved scope.
  • Review invoices across multiple vendors and contracts, effectively managing complex and high-volume review environments.
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with clients and vendors to facilitate communication and timely resolution of issues identified during the invoice review process.
  • Identify non-compliance issues and clearly document findings and associated cost impacts in a concise and accurate manner.
  • Describe identified issues and request appropriate corrective actions in accordance with established procedures.
  • Maintain complete and well-organized electronic and paper work papers documenting review procedures, findings, reviewed amounts, and payment recommendations.
  • Create, manipulate, and analyze spreadsheets to support invoice reviews, reconciliations, and tracking.
  • Maintain accurate and timely invoice tracking logs to support payment workflows and reporting.
  • Work independently while exercising sound professional judgment, and seek appropriate guidance and clarification when needed.
  • Collaborate effectively with other members of the audit and project team to ensure consistent application of review procedures.

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience reviewing and/or processing construction invoices or payment applications.
  • Construction contract compliance experience.
  • Previous knowledge of the construction industry.
  • Experience with all construction project delivery methods.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify discrepancies and inconsistencies.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to evaluate complex cost and contract information.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document and explain findings.
  • Strong professional customer service skills and ability to work effectively with clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders.

What’s In It For You:

  • Company-paid life and disability insurance
  • Optional benefits like pet insurance, legal, and supplemental health plans
  • 401(k) with day-one eligibility. You’ll get a 100% match on the first 3% of your eligible compensation and 50% match on contributions between 3% and 5% of your pay.
  • Generous time off: 10 paid holidays and PTO starting at 15 days, growing up to 25
  • Access to Consertus Academy for continuous learning and development

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:

Consertus is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected status.

raw.description:
As a Platform Tester, you'll safeguard the quality of the core platform behind Intelerad's medical imaging solutions: the services, APIs, integrations, and infrastructure that healthcare providers rely on every day. Building on a strong testing foundation, you'll own test strategy for platform components, expand automated coverage across back-end and integration layers, and partner with Engineering, DevOps, and Product teams. Together you'll make sure every release is stable, scalable, and ready for clinical environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Test Strategy: Own test planning and execution for assigned platform components and services. Define coverage across functional, integration, regression, and non-functional testing to reduce release risk.

  • Automation & CI/CD Integration: Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for APIs, services, and back-end systems. Integrate them into CI/CD pipelines to shorten feedback cycles and increase release confidence.

  • Integration & Non-Functional Testing: Validate platform behaviour across interfaces and deployment environments. This includes interoperability (e.g., DICOM, HL7), performance, scalability, and upgrade and migration scenarios.

  • Defect Analysis & Resolution: Investigate complex, cross-component issues using logs, data, and system diagnostics to isolate root causes. Partner with engineering teams to drive timely resolution and prevent recurrence.

  • Quality Practice & Mentorship: Contribute to platform testing standards and quality metrics. Guide Software Testers on platform testing approaches, tooling, and best practices.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • 5+ years of experience in software testing or quality assurance, including experience testing integrated, multi-service, or platform-level systems, or equivalent experience.

  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining test automation frameworks for API and integration testing.

  • Working knowledge of SQL, test management tooling (e.g., qTest, Zephyr), and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience testing within containerized or cloud-based environments (e.g., AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Demonstrated ability to lead test strategy for complex releases with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

  • Experience with performance and load testing tools for distributed systems.

  • Healthcare IT or medical imaging domain knowledge (e.g., PACS, RIS, DICOM) is a plus.

  • ISTQB certification or equivalent.

This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.

Intelerad is a total compensation company. Pay is dependent on the position offered. raw.description:
We're looking for an experienced Cloud Architect to join our organization. In this role, you will be responsible for the architecture, governance, and cost-effective operation of Ergomed's Cloud (Microsoft Azure) environment. This hands-on role leads the design of new and improvements to existing Azure projects, builds reusable deployment templates and standards, and provides architectural review across the tenant — collaborating with project teams on solution design and standards, with IT stakeholders on demonstrable compliance (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA), and with IT Operations on day-to-day support

  • Lead the architecture of new and existing Azure projects, recommending solutions and reviewing designs to ensure strong, repeatable foundations tailored to meet organizational requirements and business objectives
  • Analyze current infrastructure and applications to identify optimization opportunities, cost reduction strategies, and migration pathways to cloud environments
  • Drive improvements in Azure cost management: cost drivers, budgets and alerts, Advisor reviews, and reservation/commitment strategies.
  • Build and maintain reusable project templates and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) modules so new workloads are provisioned consistently and correctly.
  • • Lead the identification and resolution of architecture gaps, risks, and blockers surfaced through ongoing tenant review, working with relevant teams to close them.
  • Develop, implement and maintain cloud governance frameworks, security policies, and compliance standards to ensure adherence to industry regulations and organizational standards
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including DevOps engineers, security specialists, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into solution architectures that meets Ergomed's cloud standards and updating those standards where required
  • Lead the identification and resolution of architecture gaps, risks, and blockers surfaced through ongoing tenant review, working with relevant teams to close them.
  • Define and maintain tagging, naming, and subscription-structure standards, driving their consistent adoption across the tenant.
  • Work with IT Security and workload teams to achieve and maintain demonstrable compliance (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA), putting the right controls in place so compliance status can be evidenced at any time.
  • Evaluate and recommend cloud technologies, tools, and services that align with organizational needs, including containerization platforms, orchestration systems, and infrastructure-as-code solutions
  • Oversee cloud infrastructure deployments, ensuring scalability, reliability, and disaster recovery capabilities are properly implemented and tested
  • Establish best practices for cloud resource management, including monitoring, performance optimization, and automated provisioning
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development and operations teams on cloud architecture patterns and cloud-native application design

**Required Qualifications:**

  • Extensive experience in IT infrastructure, systems engineering, or cloud architecture, with significant hands-on experience designing and running Azure environments.
  • Demonstrated experience in a cloud architecture or senior technical role
  • Deep, hands-on Azure architecture expertise: landing zones, management groups, networking, identity, storage, compute, and security.
  • Proven ability to design and build reusable deployment templates using Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Bicep, Terraform, ARM).
  • Strong understanding of Azure cost management: cost drivers, budgets and alerts, reservations/savings plans, and Azure Advisor
  • Experience defining and enforcing cloud governance frameworks: Azure Policy, management groups, RBAC, and tagging/naming standards.
  • Experience maintaining compliance against frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA, including control implementation and audit evidence.
  • Ability to translate architectural designs into operational requirements, working with IT Operations on support models.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of resolving complex cloud infrastructure issues.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, able to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences.
  • Familiarity with GxP and GAMP5 frameworks, and experience supporting regulated (validated) cloud systems.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  • Experience with multi-cloud strategies and hybrid cloud architectures
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration platforms
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Experience with cloud cost optimization and FinOps principles
  • Experience with serverless architectures and microservices design patterns
  • Background in enterprise application migration and modernization projects

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Clinical trials, safety studies, and audits make safe and innovative pharmaceutical-led care possible. As part of Ergomed Group, you help patients benefit so they experience more of life’s meaningful moments. Biopharmaceutical companies are our clients. Patients are our purpose.

Ergomed Group brings together Ergomed CRO, PrimeVigilance, Prudentia, and ADAMAS Consulting to help biopharmaceutical companies develop, deliver and safeguard therapies in oncology, rare disease and other complex areas of medicine. Across the Group, our teams turn the signals that clinical trials, safety systems and quality data generate into insight that helps bring safer treatments to patients around the world.

The science and analysis that guides our work is demanding. And this is where we excel. What defines us, though, is how we work together. Across countries, cultures and time zones, we bring kindness, curiosity and a shared sense of purpose to work that genuinely matters. Ideas are welcome here. Growth is expected. And every person has room to make a real difference to patients' lives.

Whether you are early in your career or bringing decades of experience, we want you to feel valued for what you do and for who you are. If that sounds like the place you have been looking for, we would love to hear from you.

raw.excerpt: At Ensono, our Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things!
raw.description:
At Ensono, our Purpose is to be a relentless ally, disrupting the status quo and unleashing our clients to Do Great Things! We enable our clients to achieve key business outcomes that reshape how our world runs. As an expert technology adviser and managed service provider with cross-platform certifications, Ensono empowers our clients to keep up with continuous change and embrace innovation.

We can Do Great Things because we have great Associates. The Ensono Core Values unify our diverse talents and are woven into how we do business. These five traits are the key to achieving our purpose.

HONESTY, RELIABILITY, COLLABORATION, CURIOSITY, PASSION

Role Summary

Provide premium DB2 sysprog support and services to Ensono mainframe clients as they relate to Mainframe DB2 systems. The successful candidate will perform mainframe database software upgrades coupled with administration and tuning to support our customers’ DB2 environments. The individual will need to work with vendor personnel to achieve timely solutions of database problems. The individual will be responsible for day-to-day database maintenance such as creating backups, performing restores, monitoring file extent growth, scheduling reorganizations, creating and maintaining DR procedures and overall support of customer needs and requests. The successful candidate will be called upon to perform a variety of database optimizations that will include general reporting and analysis of the efficiency of the database configuration and periodic review of database performance.

What You Will Do:

  • Expertise and work efforts will focus on the development and support and/or the customization of new services and support efforts.
  • System programming knowledge of multiple DBMS’s is a bonus.
  • The individual will need to participate in on-call responsibilities.
  • Fulfill customer service orders (CSOs) for mainframe z/OS customers in a timely manner as they pertain to DB2
  • Provide primary support for reported problems related to DB2 tables spaces
  • Provide support on 24 x 7 x 365 basis across multiple time zones.
  • Provide key support for customer migration services (new customer transitions) as they pertain to DB2 and related OEM software products.
  • Assist the assigned project manager in the migration of newly acquired customers such that all technical hurdles are addressed in a timely manner and do not impede the expected progress of the transition nor the targeted migration date.
  • In joint cooperation with the Disaster Recovery Services, successfully execute tasks associated with any given customer’s disaster recovery plans.
  • Adhere to a schedule that efficiently manages resources and allows timely implementations.
  • Follow ITSM change control procedures

We want all new Associates to succeed in their roles at Ensono. That's why we've outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it's important that you meet all Required Qualifications. If you do not meet all of the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply. 

What You Will Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree required and/or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in DB2 for administration and systems programming support.
  • Knowledgeable in best practices of software management, maintenance and documentation
  • SMP/e experience
  • Experience with configuring and managing DB2 in a parallel sysplex environment
  • Ability to develop innovation, strategies, processes and best practices in software management
  • Experience with establishing policies and procedures pertaining to database management, DR, security, maintenance, and utilization
  • Experience with reviewing new versions of DB2 for functionality, advising how they benefit the client
  • Ability to evaluate change requests and determine impact to assigned clients and troubleshooting and solving production database issues.
  • Experience with supporting DB2 security requests
  • Ability to review DB2 security to find potential risks
  • Experience with reorganization of application data
  • Experience with reviewing, tuning of internal DB2 buffer pools and SQL code
  • Demonstrated ability to respond quickly and effectively to support requests from multiple clients
  • Supporting multiple customer for after hours on-call

Other Qualifications

  • IDAA, CA and IBM tools for DB2 are a plus
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently.
  • Demonstrated ability to respond quickly and effectively to support requests from multiple clients
  • Must be able to multi-task and work under short deadlines and in high pressure situations.
  • Excellent communication skills (written, verbal and presentations)
  • Ability to work as part of a team, as well as independently.

Why Ensono?

Ensono is a place to make better happen – for our clients and for your career. You can do great things through innovation or collaboration, by learning or volunteering, or to promote diversity and inclusion. You can do great things for your own health or for a healthier planet. Whatever it means to you to do great things we want Ensono to be the place you can do it.

We are a client-facing business, but we do encourage clients to allow us to work remotely most of the time so if you are not required to be on a client site, you can choose to work from home or in our Ensono offices.

Some of our benefits include:

  • Unlimited Paid Days Off
  • Three health plan options
  • 401k with company match
  • Eligibility for dental, vision, short and long-term disability, life and AD&D coverage, and flexible spending accounts
  • Family Forming Benefit including fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy reimbursement
  • Paid childbearing and paternal leave
  • Education Reimbursement, Student Loan Assistance or 529 College Funding
  • Sabbatical leave
  • Wellness program
  • Flexible work schedule

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay scale for this role is $65,000 to $123,000 salary, based on a fulltime schedule. About Scale Media

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.

If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

The Role

We're looking for a Director, Growth to lead our paid acquisition team and raise the bar on performance across our portfolio of DTC wellness brands.

We expect Meta and paid social to be our biggest growth levers. You'll bring deep platform expertise and the drive to be in the numbers every day: reading performance, spotting what changed and why, and working with the team on what to do about it. You'll set the standard for how we buy media, make sure every platform gets clean, complete data, and make our media buyers sharper every week. You'll also allocate budget across channels against the CAC, ROAS, and MER targets we set.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You won't be setting up campaigns or launching ads yourself, but you'll be in the accounts daily, diagnosing problems and helping make the calls on account architecture, bid strategy, audience strategy, and budget pacing. You'll work closely with Creative, Ecommerce, and Analytics, and help us build AI-enabled workflows that make our media buying faster and sharper.

You'll report to the VP of Growth.

What You'll Own

  • Daily performance management. Reviewing performance every day across brands and channels, catching issues and opportunities early, and driving the team to act on them.
  • Leading the paid acquisition team. Managing and developing our media buyers: reviewing accounts with them, pressure-testing decisions, and building their judgment.
  • Media buying standards. Setting and raising the bar on how we buy Meta and paid social: account architecture, bid strategy, audience strategy, and budget pacing.
  • Platform data quality. Making sure we send the right data into every platform: pixels and Conversions API firing correctly, the right event parameters, and audience exclusions set up properly.
  • Landing pages, creative, and copy. Working with media buyers, Creative, and Ecommerce to decide which pages to launch and where creative and copy need to improve.
  • Budget allocation. Allocating and pacing budget across paid channels to hit the CAC, ROAS, and MER targets set with the VP of Growth.
  • Testing. Running a structured test roadmap across audiences, offers, landing pages, and campaign settings, and turning results into clear next moves.
  • Performance reads. Working with Analytics to read performance through MTA and lift testing, and acting on what the results show.
  • AI-enabled workflows. Using AI tools and automation to speed up reporting, analysis, creative tagging, and optimization.
  • Agencies and vendors. Managing agency or vendor support where relevant.

What Success Looks Like

  • Double-digit new customer revenue growth while hitting brand and product-level efficiency targets
  • Scaled Meta and paid social spend across brands
  • A daily performance rhythm where problems are caught and fixed in days, not weeks
  • Clean, consistent account structures that are easier to scale and diagnose
  • Reliable platform data, with no pixel/CAPI event or audience gaps
  • A media buying team that makes stronger decisions on its own
  • Faster testing velocity, with a clear backlog and documented learnings
  • A higher hit rate on new landing pages, creative, and copy

What We're Looking For

  • Deep Meta and paid social expertise. You've personally managed 8-figure Meta spend for consumer brands, know the platform inside out, and have a playbook on how to scale without losing efficiency that adapts as the platform evolves.
  • Drive to be in the numbers every day. You look at performance daily because you want to, you notice when something moves, and you don't rest until you understand and address it.
  • People leadership. You've managed media buyers and made them measurably better through direct feedback, account reviews, and clear standards.
  • Tracking fluency. You understand pixels, Conversions API, event parameters, and audience exclusions well enough to spot problems and specify fixes.
  • Cross-channel budget experience. You've allocated budget across more than one paid channel and can make tradeoffs between them.
  • Conversion and creative judgment. You can look at a landing page, ad, or piece of copy and say specifically what will improve performance.
  • Testing discipline. You design clean tests, read results honestly, and know when a learning is real.
  • Analytical strength. You're comfortable working through performance data, attribution gaps, and the limits of platform-reported numbers.
  • AI fluency. You actively use AI tools to speed up analysis, reporting, and execution.
  • Cross-functional partnership. You work well with Creative, Ecommerce, and Analytics without adding unnecessary process.
  • 7–10 years of relevant experience, including managing media buyers.

Strong candidate backgrounds include:

  • Meta or paid social leads at scaled DTC brands
  • Senior media buyers who have managed a team of buyers
  • Agency paid social leads who've run large ecommerce accounts

Preferred, but Not Required

  • Experience with TikTok or other paid social channels
  • Hands-on Google Search, YouTube, and Performance Max experience
  • Experience in supplements, wellness, beauty, or consumer subscription businesses
  • Experience operating across multi-brand portfolios

What We Offer

  • Salary: $140,000–$200,000, depending on experience
  • Excellent medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • Fully remote, full-time position
  • Monthly WFH stipend
  • Generous paid time off program
  • Discounted products
  • An amazing team to work alongside

raw.title: Senior Account Manager
raw.excerpt: About AMZ Advisers:AMZ Advisers is a digital media marketing agency focused on developing and implementing strategic marketing plans for the global Amazon marketplaces.
raw.description:
About AMZ Advisers:

AMZ Advisers is a digital media marketing agency focused on developing and implementing strategic marketing plans for the global Amazon marketplaces. Working at AMZ Advisers allows you to apply your skills, expertise, and passions to directly impact the lives and business of other people and entrepreneurs. Our staff solves dynamic, quickly evolving problems with our Founders, in-house team, and network of partnered tech companies. Our Account Management team is organized into pods, consisting of Senior Account Managers (SAMs), Junior Account Managers (JAMs), and Apprentices and Interns. This structure fosters knowledge sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning.

About the Role:

We’re seeking a driven and self-motivated problem solver with exceptionally strong communication skills and the ability to build long-lasting client relationships. We offer a fast-paced, challenging, and creative environment where you will be provided the opportunity to sharpen your analytical, communication, and strategic development skills. You will be offered resources and growth opportunities to learn more about online marketing to enhance your professional career.

The ideal candidate is an independent thinker who can confidently manage multiple Amazon Seller and Vendor Central accounts while leading client relationships with a high level of ownership and professionalism. As an Account Manager, this person will be responsible for building strong strategies, guiding clients through clear and proactive communication, and ensuring their portfolio is progressing toward the right goals. They should be comfortable working closely with their Brand Strategist and cross-functional pod members, while taking the lead on day-to-day account direction, strategic execution, and client success.

This is a fully remote position. If hired, you will join a company with an amazing and talented staff.

What You’ll Do:

General Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of clients, gradually growing to approximately 10 accounts, while maintaining a high retention rate.

  • Build strong, long-term client relationships through clear, proactive, and confident communication.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring they feel informed, supported, and strategically guided at all times.

  • Set clear expectations with clients and manage those expectations throughout the lifecycle of the account.

  • Conduct regular strategy calls with clients to review performance, communicate progress, explain results, and align on upcoming priorities.

  • Build, track, and monitor KPIs for all accounts under personal portfolio management.

  • Conduct audits of client accounts and use data to identify opportunities, blockers, and areas for improvement.

  • Develop strategic growth plans tailored to each client’s goals, lifecycle stage, and account conditions.

  • Proactively identify and recommend strategies to improve account performance across sales, traffic, conversion, profitability, inventory, content, and advertising.

  • Report on account progress, key action items, and next-step priorities in a clear and organized way.

  • Plan, coordinate, and oversee promotions, launches, and marketplace initiatives in alignment with the broader account strategy.

  • Coordinate the resolution of account issues by working with internal teams and escalating through the appropriate channels when needed.

  • Use internal and external software tools to analyze account performance and support strategy development.

  • Work cross-functionally with Ads, Specialists, Content, Onboarding, and Strategists to ensure strategies are executed effectively and aligned to client goals.

  • Attend Account Management meetings, trainings, and ongoing development sessions on a weekly or bi-weekly basis.

  • Participate in daily stand-up meetings to raise blockers, align on priorities, and maintain execution momentum.

Strategy Ownership

  • Conduct account audits and turn findings into clear, actionable strategies.

  • Build client strategies based on data, marketplace trends, account health, business goals, and realistic opportunity areas.

  • Understand how to prioritize focus SKUs based on performance, profitability, traffic potential, conversion, and growth opportunity.

  • Adjust strategies as needed based on data, seasonality, competitive changes, and evolving client objectives.

  • Ensure every recommendation has a clear reason behind it and can be explained confidently to the client.

Advertising & Amazon Knowledge

  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of Amazon as a whole, including traffic, conversion, listing quality, profitability, inventory, account health, and category dynamics.

  • Understand Amazon advertising strategy well enough to contribute meaningfully to planning, decision-making, and client communication.

  • Be able to interpret ad performance, identify high-level opportunities or inefficiencies, and connect advertising decisions to the broader business strategy.

  • Work closely with the Ads team and Strategist to align ad direction with overall account goals, whether those goals are growth, profitability, ranking, launch velocity, or market share.

  • Communicate ad strategy and performance to clients in a way that is clear, accurate, and tied back to business outcomes.

Pod Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Brand Strategist within the pod to refine account strategy, validate recommendations, and escalate higher-level concerns when needed.

  • Collaborate with pod members regularly through meetings, brainstorming sessions, and strategy discussions.

  • Keep internal teams aligned by ensuring priorities, deadlines, and strategic direction are clearly communicated.

  • Support a collaborative pod environment where ideas, blockers, and opportunities are surfaced early.

Client Communication & Relationship Management

  • Lead proactive, transparent, and solutions-oriented communication with clients.

  • Build trust by not only reporting on what happened, but clearly explaining why it happened, what it means, and what should happen next.

  • Be able to handle difficult conversations, performance concerns, and conflicting client goals with confidence and professionalism.

  • Guide clients toward the right strategic decisions, even when those decisions require pushback or expectation resetting.

  • Ensure clients feel that their accounts are being actively managed, thoughtfully reviewed, and strategically guided.

  • Encourage client feedback and use it to strengthen the relationship and improve the service experience.

  • Help identify retention risks early and take action before they become larger client issues.

Check-ins, Accountability & Growth Opportunities

  • Regularly review account progress and raise issues, risks, or missed opportunities early.

  • Stay proactive in identifying upsell and expansion opportunities where appropriate.

  • Take ownership of account outcomes and maintain strong follow-through on action items.

  • Continuously look for ways to improve account performance, internal processes, and the client experience.

How We’ll Measure Success

  • Retention Rate - Percentage of retained clients from month to month.

  • Blocker/ Conflict Resolution Time - Monitor and decrease the time taken to resolve client issues or blockers.

  • Client Communication - Assess the quality and frequency of client interactions for improved satisfactions.

  • Strategy Effectiveness - Evaluate the success of client strategies considering feedback and performance metrics.

Qualifications:

  • BA in Marketing, Business Development, Management, or other related studies.

  • 2+ years with client account management.

  • 2+ years digital marketing or eCommerce experience.

  • 1+ year experience with Amazon Seller and or Vendor Central.

  • Ability to build and maintain client relations.

  • Active listening and the ability to understand client needs.

  • Proactive, go-getter mindset who functions well within a team setting but can work independently.

  • Strong ability to think outside the box, willingness to test new ideas, and develop and implement growth strategies.

  • Strong time management skills and the ability to multitask.

  • Ability and desire to learn new skills.

Technologies We Use:

  • G-Suite: Gmail, Google Drive, Google Meets, Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides

  • Microsoft: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

  • ClickUp

  • Nordpass

  • Slack

  • Sellerboard

  • Data Dive

  • Zoom

To Apply Please Include the Following:

  • Your CV/ Resume in English (ONLY English Resumes will be considered)

  • Two references who can attest to your competency in this line of work

  • Answers to the following questions:

    • Describe your experience with Amazon Seller or Vendor Central.

    • Do you have any experience leading a team?

    • Why are you interested in a new job/ this position?

    • Describe a situation in your career in which you were faced with a challenging problem and how you overcame it.

About Magic

Magic is a leading modern outsourcing platform that connects SMBs to high-quality remote workers, from SDRs to virtual assistants and more. With roots in Silicon Valley, and backing from top venture capitalists, our workers are supercharged with a combination of the latest AI technology and training.

Role Purpose

We are seeking experienced and driven Business Development Managers (Account Executives) who are passionate about helping fast-growing businesses achieve their goals. As a BDM, you will own the end-to-end sales cycle—from initial outreach and discovery to closing and onboarding—while consistently creating value and fostering lasting client relationships.

We will give you 50+ warm inbound leads per month. Your job? Own them. All the way.
From discovery to close, from "not now" to "let's revisit", your success will come from your grit, discipline, curiosity, and accountability. We're looking for high-performing Account Executives who are obsessed with results, coachable to the core, and treat every lead like gold.

Key Areas of Impact and Focus:

Core Responsibilities:
  • Own the full sales cycle from inbound discovery to follow-up, closing, and successful onboarding, ensuring a smooth transition for new clients and hitting quota monthly
  • Run 15+ discovery calls per week with C-level and Director-level prospects; uncover pain, establish urgency, and align the right product
  • Know when to position which Magic product by becoming a true product expert and match offerings to prospect needs with precision
  • Treat every lead like a win waiting to happen by working “not now” leads with discipline and creativity until the timing is right
  • Work every deal to completion and don’t let momentum die; follow up persistently, update next steps, and never lose track of potential
  • Own your pipeline like a pro while keeping HubSpot clean, prioritize outreach, and maintain deal velocity at all times
  • Collaborate with Sales, Support, and Ops Teams to ensure clients start strong and are set up for long-term success
  • Share what’s working and learn what’s not bringing a growth mindset to every deal, and adapt quickly when SOPs, experiments, or strategies evolve
  • Continuously learn and improve, seeking feedback, applying it fast, and treating personal growth like part of the job
  • Stay consistent, stay hungry while showing up with energy, drive, and the mindset that every day is an opportunity to win

What Winning Looks Like:
  • You handle 2 to 8 discovery calls per day and never drop the ball
  • You don’t let soft “no's” die. You work the deal until the answer is final
  • You actively ask, “What could I do better?” and apply the feedback fast
  • You own your pipeline like you personally paid for the lead. Every lead, every stage, is tracked and followed up on
  • You’re not waiting for opportunities, you’re creating them in your pipeline

Who This Role is Not For:
  • You blame the leads, the tools, or the process, rather than asking what you could do better
  • You need a manager to tell you what to do every day
  • You think leads manage themselves and don’t believe in persistent, proactive follow-up
  • You don’t take the initiative to improve; you wait for someone to tell you what to fix
  • You treat “bad timing” or “not now” as dead ends instead of future wins to nurture

Qualified Candidate Requirements:

Qualification Requirements

  • Experience Fit: 2+ years of B2B sales experience (SMB/Mid-Market, U.S. or Canada), with a proven track record selling SaaS, subscription services, AI, or outsourcing to executive-level buyers.
  • GTM Fit: You’ve thrived in high-volume inbound environments and treat every lead with the tenacity and structure of an outbound opportunity (no stone left unturned).
  • Sales Style Fit: You’re a consultative, relationship-first seller who drives urgency, uncovers pain, and positions value across multiple stakeholders.
  • Mindset Fit: Hungry, gritty, coachable, self-accountable, and you take ownership of outcomes and don’t wait to be told what to fix.
  • Culture Fit: You thrive in a fast-changing startup, are mature, proactive, curious, and a driver of team momentum.
  • Tech Fluency: You’re strong with HubSpot, AI tools, and modern sales platforms, using technology to go faster.
  • Start Date: You can start on February 9, 2026

Key Time Zone Schedule Requirements

  • Work Schedule: 9-hour shifts following US business hours between 9:00 AM - 8:00 PM Eastern Time
  • Training Schedule: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM Eastern Time (mandatory attendance)
  • Time Zone Alignment: Must be able to consistently work in Eastern Time, including adjustments for Daylight Saving Time
  • Availability: Monday to Friday, with consistent availability during U.S. business hours

Equipment Requirements (Self-Provided)

  • Computer/laptop meeting company specifications
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection (minimum 50 Mbps download/10 Mbps upload)
  • Professional headset for clear client communication
  • Quiet, distraction-free work environment
  • Backup power/internet solution for uninterrupted client service

Traits of a Top Performer at Magic Sales Team

  • Hunger: You chase results and hate leaving potential on the table
  • Grit: You keep pushing when it gets hard because that’s where wins happen
  • Coachability: You treat feedback like fuel
  • Maturity: You treat leads like gold and time like your most valuable asset
  • Ownership: You drive your own success; you don’t wait for it
  • Problem Solver: You look for paths forward, not reasons it won’t work

Application Process

Why Top Sales Performers Choose Magic

Limitless Earning Potential

Under the oversight of the CRA-Manager the person ensures compliance of study conduct with ICH/GCP and country regulations, our company's policies and procedures, quality standards and adverse event reporting requirements internally and externally.

Acts as primary site contact and site manager throughout all phases of a clinical research study, taking overall responsibility of allocated sites.

Actively develops and expands the territory for clinical research, finding and developing new sites.

Participates in internal meetings and workstreams as SME for monitoring processes and

Systems.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Develops strong site relationships and ensures continuity of site relationships through all phases of the trial.
  • Performs clinical study site management/monitoring activities in compliance with ICH-GCP, Sponsor SOPs, Local Laws & Regulations, Protocol, Site Monitoring Plan and associated documents.
  • Gains an in-depth understanding of the study protocol and related procedures.
  • Coordinates & manages various tasks in collaboration with other sponsor roles to achieve Site Ready.
  • Participates & provides inputs on site selection and validation activities.
  • Performs remote and on-site monitoring & oversight activities using various tools to ensure:
    • Data generated at site are complete, accurate and unbiased.
    • Subjects’ right, safety and well-being are protected.

  • Conducts site visits including but not limited to validation visits, initiation visits, monitoring visits, close-out visits and records clear, comprehensive and accurate visit & non-visit contact reports appropriately in a timely manner.
  • Collects, reviews, and monitors required regulatory documentation for study start-up, study maintenance and study close-out.
  • Communicates with Investigators and site staff on issues related to protocol conduct, recruitment, retention, protocol deviations, regulatory documentation, site audits/inspections and overall site performance.
  • Identifies, assesses and resolves site performance, quality or compliance problems and escalates per defined CRA Escalation Pathway as appropriate in collaboration with CRA-Manager, CRM, TA Head and CRD as needed.

raw.excerpt: About DeweyLearnDeweyLearn exists to help organizations preserve and scale expert judgment.
raw.description:
About DeweyLearn

DeweyLearn exists to help organizations preserve and scale expert judgment. We believe the most valuable knowledge in any organization doesn’t live in manuals or policies, it lives in the decisions experts make every day. Our platform captures that expertise, transforms it into scalable AI systems, and applies it to authentic assessment, coaching, certification, quality assurance, and any workflow where human judgment matters.

DeweyLearn is an AI-powered human assessment and evaluation platform. Our multimodal system analyzes audio and video of real learning, training, and coaching sessions using observational frameworks developed with domain experts, then turns what it sees into structured insight for assessment, coaching, certification, and quality assurance. Our partners span higher education, corporate training, clinical practice, and K-12 education.

DeweyLearn won the GSV Cup grand prize at the 2026 ASU+GSV Summit as the world’s best edtech startup, and recently closed a Series A led by SJF Ventures.

Tasks

About the role

You own end-to-end product management across existing verticals, new verticals, and internal tooling. Working with the Head of Product, you take a focused approach to understanding the problem, and building, validating, launching, and improving a solution that people actually use. Use cases might include a nursing simulation workflow, a repeatable solution for an existing customer need, or an internal tool that helps our team deliver faster.

This is a hands-on building role. You use agentic tools to compose existing DeweyLearn and third-party capabilities, configure workflows, and test working solutions. You partner with Customer Success and domain experts to understand the use case, and with Engineering and Product Delivery to deliver it successfully. You own the assigned product’s outcomes, then take on new opportunities as the solution becomes repeatable, and ongoing ownership is clear.

Requirements

What you'll do

Understand the use case: Partner with Sales, Customer Success, customers, and domain experts to identify the problem, current process, and evidence of value.

  • Build the complete solution. Configure workflows, prompts, evaluation frameworks, and integrations using existing capabilities and agentic tools. Work with Engineering when platform changes are needed.
  • Validate in real use. Test the full customer or internal workflow against agreed quality criteria, review failures with relevant domain and technical owners, and iterate.
  • Launch and drive adoption. Coordinate readiness, onboarding, and handover with Product Delivery. Partner with Customer Success and Product Marketing on demos, enablement, and feedback.
  • Own the outcomes. Track useful adoption, quality, time to first value, and commercial contribution. For internal tools, demonstrate time savings, improved throughput, or reduced errors.
  • Make it repeatable. Reduce bespoke setup and support, build reusable workflows, and turn user learning into product improvements and roadmap input for the Head of Product.

About the Candidate

  • Curiosity and adaptability: You learn new domains quickly and recognize when to involve specialists or engineers. You can move between industries and internal use cases while staying focused on outcomes. Experience in education, assessment, workflow automation, integrations, or AI evaluation is helpful, not required.
  • Agentic building: You use AI tools to build working solutions, inspect outputs critically, troubleshoot failures, and improve them. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you enjoy making things work.
  • Ownership and judgment: You can show useful things you have built and shipped, and explain your decisions and results. You may be early in your career; demonstrated ownership matters more than years in a PM title. Personal, academic, internal, and customer projects all count.
  • Customer-close learning: You seek out users and domain experts, test assumptions in real workflows, and turn what you learn into concrete changes. You follow through beyond a demo and communicate tradeoffs clearly.

What this role is not

  • Not a role with a ready-made playbook—you won’t always have a defined roadmap, established tools, or an existing solution. The Head of Product sets priorities; you take ownership of figuring out how to achieve the outcome.
  • Not a coordination-only role — you build working solutions and own product outcomes, rather than only writing specs or tracking delivery.
  • Not a solo engineering or domain-expert role — you work hands-on with agentic tools while partnering with customers, Customer Success, specialists, Engineering, and Product Delivery.

How we hire

We care about what you can do and how you think, not where you've done it. We're hiring for talent that amplifies the team. We evaluate candidates on concrete examples, demonstrably deep knowledge, and real work samples — and on the judgment and self-direction that come from having done work like this before, without a manager scripting the moves.

The team you're joining

DeweyLearn is a small, close-knit team, moving fast, with a deep conviction in the impact DeweyLearn can have on learning and learners. We emphasize fun and a high level of collaboration, while holding each other accountable to our shared outcomes. We hire on ability and judgment, not pedigree, and we trust deeply once we do. We bias toward straight talk, deliver on what we said we would, and treat play and curiosity as part of how the team discovers what to build. We refuse to ship work we wouldn't be proud of.

Benefits

Compensation & logistics

Medical benefits and flexible PTO. Remote-first, with occasional travel for customer visits and team events.

Our dedicated and compassionate employees are driven by a common mission: To deliver the cures of tomorrow to the people who need them today.

The IT Internal Auditor is responsible for supporting and executing information technology audits across City of Hope and related entities. This role evaluates IT governance, cybersecurity, infrastructure, application controls, and data management processes while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. You will partner closely with business and technology leaders to assess risk, strengthen internal controls, and support the secure and effective use of technology across the organization.

As a successful candidate, you will:

  • Execute IT audits across cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud environments, applications, and data governance

  • Conduct technical testing, including automated controls and data analytics

  • Identify emerging technology risks, including cybersecurity threats and evolving industry trends
  • Perform audit fieldwork including interviews, walkthroughs, and analysis of system controls
  • Validate remediation efforts and conduct follow-up testing to ensure risk mitigation

Your qualifications should include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Accounting, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 2–5 years of IT audit, cybersecurity, IT risk, or related experience
  • Certification such as CISA, CIA, CPA, or CISSP (or progress toward certification)
  • Strong knowledge of IT audit frameworks and standards (e.g., COBIT, NIST, ISO)
  • Understanding of cybersecurity risks, controls, and IT general controls

DB Global Technology, Deutsche Bank's technology center in Central and Eastern Europe, opened its Bucharest office in January 2014 and is continuously expanding. raw.description:
Company Overview:Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody. Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

The Practice Access Manager (PAM) is a customer-facing role that will be responsible for managing defined accounts within a specific region or territory, to support access for providers. The role will provide education to healthcare providers and office staff on access services and reimbursement solutions based on manufacturer business rules and the BlinkRx platform.

The PAM will demonstrate a compliant and consultative approach providing education to offices related to the BlinkRx access solutions and prior authorizations.

What You’ll Do:

  • Educate and inform health care providers and their staff of the services and benefits offered by BlinkRx to help patients get on and stay on medication therapy as prescribed
  • Engage with providers and their staff to reconfirm the benefits and grow their usage of BlinkRx
  • Conduct proactive outbound outreach to provider offices via phone, identifying and acting on growth opportunities, and positioning access solutions for new and existing patients
  • Maintain ongoing account conversations and relationships across an assigned territory. Managing a regular cadence of touchpoints, tracking engagement, and ensuring continuity of service for provider offices
  • Act as the first point of contact for an office regarding any inquiries with a specific prescription or patient, while serving as the voice of the field within BlinkRx. Build personal relationships with practices and offices to create an experience they value, removing barriers to access.
  • Create custom profiles for the healthcare providers preferences for prior authorization support and status updates
  • Become the go-to resource for both reactive and proactive engagement with the Brand Field team by assisting with any Healthcare Provider and BlinkRx related questions
  • Introduce partner field reps to BlinkRx as an option for healthcare providers and their patients
  • Compliantly provide approved communication to healthcare providers regarding the status of their patients

What You’ll Need:

  • Fluent in both English and Spanish (written and verbal) to effectively serve our Spanish-speaking clients
  • Background in pharmacy sales, healthcare account management, or outbound sales in a healthcare/pharma setting is strongly preferred
  • Understanding of prescription workflows and how they operate across provider offices and pharmacy channel
  • Solution oriented mindset with strong analytic capabilities
  • A natural client success and account management ability with exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, as well as a keen ability to build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external clients.
  • Comfort with an outbound call motion. Must have the ability to contact provider offices, introduce new products or services, and drive conversations forward with confidence and professionalism
  • Willingness to travel as business needs demand, including attendance at internal training sessions, industry conferences, and occasional in-person HCP (Healthcare Provider) visits.
  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment
  • Ability to prioritize duties and manage multiple projects from start to finish with minimal supervision. Strong time-management and organizational skills
  • Must be able to exercise strict confidentiality and have impeccable judgment
  • Ability to coordinate several tasks simultaneously
  • Experience in working with a CRM (eg Salesforce) and softphone system is preferred

Why Join Us:It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population. At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year. Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

About Centric Software:

Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.

Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.

OUR VISION FOR THIS ROLE:

In your new role as Site Reliability Engineer, you will support us right in the heart of our SaaS, as an integral member of the Site Reliability Engineering team. You will be responsible for the Shoppingfeed product, working in close relations with our software developers and infrastructure engineers, but also with our security and QA colleagues.

YOUR CURRENT TASKS WITH THE OPPORTUNITY TO GROW – WHAT WILL YOUR LIFE AT CENTRIC SOFTWARE LOOK LIKE?

In your everyday work you have a diverse range of tasks with lots of space for development:

  • Diagnose and resolve application-level reliability and performances issues across the pull request path (nginx -> php-fpm -> application -> database/cache)
  • Tune and scale the web-serving layer under production load — php-fpm pool sizing and process management, nginx timeouts/buffering/upstream keepalive, capacity planning.
  • Solid experience configuring and troubleshooting nginx as a reverse proxy / web server (timeouts, buffering, upstream keepalive, diagnosing 502/504s).
  • Proven experience diagnosing and resolving performance and scaling problems under load (latency, worker/pool saturation, capacity planning).
  • Develop, maintain, and support our own Docker-based workloads
  • Own the product deployment and upgrade process end to end
  • Support and troubleshoot running customer-facing services
  • Work 50% of your time with our product teams, ensuring much-needed improvements get defined, explained, worked on and rolled out
  • Continuously helping to improve both our product and the infrastructure underneath, by taking the responsibility together with your team
  • Define reliability metrics and ensure they are kept by all the systems you oversee
  • Be part of our On-Call and On-Duty rotations

YOUR PROFILE – WHAT DO YOU NEED TO FIT IN?

Minimum qualifications

  • 2+ years proven experience with Linux CLI
  • 2+ years proven experience with Docker or other container technology
  • Strong hands-on experience with PHP applications and their runtime (php-fpm process management), able to read and debug application code
  • 5+ years proven experience with GIT
  • You have good knowledge over a multitude of technologies (from Linux Kernel and Load Balancing to PHP, AWS S3, from container orchestration to MySQL/MariaDB and Elasticsearch)
  • B2 English

Preferred qualifications

  • 3+ years proven experience with configuration management tools (Ansible; Saltstack; Puppet; Chef etc)
  • 1+ years proven experience with Kubernetes
  • 3+ years proven experience managing clustered Linux servers
  • 2+ years experience working in a team, on large GIT projects
  • 3+ years proven experience with CI/CD tools (ideally Github Actions or similar tools like GitLab CI, Jenkins)
  • with a monitoring tool (ideally Datadog or prometheus/grafana or kibana/elasticsearch)
  • 2+ years proven experience managing Elasticsearch clusters
  • 2+ years proven experience managing MySQL / MariaDB
  • Proven experience troubleshooting complex issues [
  • 3+ proven experience with at least one cloud provider (ideally AWS)
  • 3+ proven experience with IaC tools (ideally Terraform)
  • proven experience with RabbitMQ is a plus

YOUR PERSONALITY – BE A PART OF OUR RELENTLESS PIONEER STRATEGY:

  • Communication: you like to share your knowledge with your colleagues and to document your work
  • Curiosity:
    You want to find out the root cause of problems and fix them permanently
    You enjoy introducing innovations and implementing improvements
    You are interested in exciting current trends and technological developments in the cloud environment like Docker and Docker Swarm, Ansible, Continuous Integration, Continuous Deployment and AWS services
  • Customer first: we are here to support our customers and do all in our power to help them
  • Initiative and Ownership: you make it, you run it, you break it, you fix it

SOME GOOD REASONS TO JOIN OUR TEAM:

  • We offer you a versatile job with high personal responsibility and global challenging tasks
  • You can work in a professional, international working environment with flat hierarchies and short decision-making paths
  • We live a co-operative and respectful corporate culture with fun at work and room for own ideas

  • A collegial and appreciative corporate culture with fun at the task and room for own ideas

  • Corporate healthcare insurance plan (after probation period)
  • Access to Company Mobility Program
  • Entitled to extra paid leave days package, starting with 25 days yearly total and growing with seniority in the Company
  • We provide possibility of therapy sessions, as part of the Employee Assistance Program

raw.description:
Description

About Coralogix

Coralogix is a full-stack observability and security platform built for modern engineering teams that need real-time visibility at scale.

Our platform brings together logs, metrics, traces, security events, infrastructure, Kubernetes, applications, and user experience in one place. With a no-index architecture and in-stream analytics, Coralogix helps customers reduce cost, retain more data, and troubleshoot faster without compromising scale or performance.

We are looking for technical sellers who can help customers understand the value of a different approach and prove it in real-world environments.

﻿This is a fully remote position, but candidates must be located within the US Eastern Time Zone (EST/EDT).

Compensation: $220,000 to $250,000 OTE

The Role

We are hiring a Solutions Engineer to join our East-Coast pre-sales team, Focusing on Enterprise FedRal Cloud Infrastructure clients.

This is a senior, hands-on technical sales role. You will partner with Account Executives to run technical discovery, lead product evaluations, design solutions, and help customers validate Coralogix in their own environments.

During evaluations, you will be expected to do more than present the platform. You will act as the technical owner, helping customers deploy, configure, integrate, troubleshoot, and validate Coralogix across their environment. You need to be credible with engineers, confident with executives, and capable of moving between architecture, code, configuration, and business value.

This role is for someone who can earn trust in technical conversations and help drive deals to a strong technical close.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the technical strategy for sales opportunities in partnership with Account Executives.
  • Lead discovery across customer architecture, telemetry sources, operational pain, business drivers, and success criteria.
  • Design and deliver tailored demonstrations that connect Coralogix to real customer use cases.
  • Manage technical evaluations and POCs from scope through validation.
  • Support hands-on deployment, configuration, integration, and troubleshooting during evaluations.
  • Work with customers across logs, metrics, traces, Kubernetes, cloud environments, applications, and security use cases.
  • Explain Coralogix’s architecture, differentiation, and value clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Identify technical risks, remove blockers, and guide customers toward a successful technical decision.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Support to represent field feedback and improve how we win.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Engineering, Pre-Sales, Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Security Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on technical ability across deployment, configuration, troubleshooting, and integration work.
  • Solid understanding of observability, including logs, metrics, traces, APM, dashboards, alerting, and infrastructure monitoring.
  • Experience leading technical evaluations, product demonstrations, and proof-of-concept processes.
  • Ability to speak credibly with engineers, DevOps, SRE, platform, and security teams.
  • Confidence engaging executives and translating technical value into business impact.
  • Practical experience with cloud-native environments, distributed systems, containers, and modern infrastructure.
  • Coding or scripting experience in languages such as Python, Go, Java, JavaScript, Bash, or similar.
  • Strong communication, ownership, follow-through, and commercial judgment.

Technical Experience

Relevant experience may include:

  • Kubernetes and containerized environments
  • AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • OpenTelemetry
  • Prometheus
  • Docker
  • APM and distributed tracing
  • Log analytics and telemetry pipelines
  • SIEM or security monitoring
  • Infrastructure monitoring
  • RUM
  • Terraform, Helm, or deployment automation
  • CI/CD workflows
  • Application instrumentation and debugging

What Success Looks Like

The best Solutions Engineers at Coralogix are not just strong presenters. They are technical owners.

They can uncover pain, define success, build a validation plan, and prove value in the customer’s environment. They are hands-on enough to earn credibility with practitioners and commercially aware enough to help move opportunities forward.

They know when to go deep, when to simplify, when to challenge, and when to escalate.

Why Join Coralogix

Observability is changing fast. Data volumes are growing, budgets are under pressure, and teams are rethinking the platforms they rely on.

Coralogix gives customers a different path: real-time analytics, open standards, strong security and observability use cases, and an architecture designed for scale.

As a Solutions Engineer, you will play a central role in strategic evaluations, competitive opportunities, and the technical decisions that help customers choose Coralogix.

﻿Compensation and Benefits

The on-target earnings range for this role is $220,000 to $250,000. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, education, and work location.

Our total rewards package includes healthcare, dental, mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan with company match, paid sick time, and paid time off.

Coralogix is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

Cultural Fit

We’re seeking candidates who are hungry, humble, and smart. Coralogix fosters a culture of innovation and continuous learning, where team members are encouraged to challenge the status quo and contribute to our shared mission. If you thrive in dynamic environments and are eager to shape the future of observability solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

Coralogix is an equal-opportunity employer and encourages applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

Finances are one of the major sources of stress in American households, and nine out of ten Americans say nothing would make them feel more confident than having their personal finances in order. At Monarch we are building the most comprehensive personal finance platform to help people improve their financial lives and achieve their goals.

The Company

Monarch came out of private beta in early 2021. Since that time we have quickly became one of the premier ways to manage your financial life. Customers love the product and we have seen rapid, organic growth. Our users say that Monarch helps them feel more confident in their finances, and more confident in their financial future.

Our founding team consists of product-driven, serial entrepreneurs with multiple exits. Additionally, our CEO was one of the original creators of and has a unique perspective on what is needed to meet consumers' needs in this market.

We are passionate about building a company, product and brand that both customers and employees love. We are well-funded by top venture firms and angel investors.

We founded the company as a fully-remote team (pre Covid!) and are open to applicants that live within a 5 hour time zone difference of US Pacific Time.

The Role

Monarch Money is seeking a Principle Software Engineer with a focus on financial data aggregation. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring Monarch reliably aggregates, enriches, and analyzes our users' financial data from various sources and at a large scale. This is a problem that is ripe for innovation, requiring technical excellence, creative problem solving, world-class product intuition, comfort with large volumes of data, and the ability to work with internal and external APIs.

This is designed to be a senior role since it is taking ownership of a new area with a lot of technical / product complexity (ie you've probably done this sort of work for years). But if you think you're equipped for the job, please apply!

Your Contribution

  • As our first data aggregation engineer, you will lead our technical efforts to make Monarch the best place to see your financial data in one place. This would include writing/improving the code and logic that aggregates, enriches, and analyzes our users' financial data.

  • You will frame the problem, put together a strategy, decide how success should be measured, prioritize projects, and execute successfully.

  • You will collaborate with and influence company and product leadership.

  • While initially working in a hands-on IC capacity, you will own this problem end-to-end, making technical trade-off (like buy vs. build) and product trade-off decisions.

  • You will help build out a team focused on this problem, for which you would have technical and/or people leadership responsibilities.

Skills

  • You have excellent product intuition, and are comfortable with both qualitative and quantitative data.

  • You are comfortable working with external APIs (like Plaid).

  • You have experience working with data pipelines and processing data in general.

  • You are comfortable (or willing to learn) Python and other backend systems.

  • You are comfortable delving into front-end work as needed.

  • [Optional] You have some experience or interest in Machine Learning.

  • [Optional] You have worked on aggregating/enriching personal financial data in the past.

$180,000 - $200,000 a year

Based on seniority and location. Equity is also offered.

Benefits

  • Work wherever you want! As a fully remote company with no central office, we want you to work wherever you are happiest and most productive. Whether that’s out of your home, a co-working space, or elsewhere.

  • Competitive cash and equity compensation in a hyper growth, early stage company 🚀.

  • Stipend to set-up your ideal working environment.

  • Medical, dental and vision benefits (Full time US only).

  • 401k (US only).

  • Unlimited PTO.

  • 3 day weekend every month! We take off the “First Friday” every month to focus on rest, recuperation, or just having fun!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
